title: hippomarathrum libanotis var. cristatum

The Mountain Carrot has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, respiratory problems, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Hippomarathrum libanotis var. cristatum include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve pain and discomfort in the body.
